thought: Ge Zhenlin is the deputy squad leader, so he needs to be visually distinct from the commanding squad leader Ma Baoyu. While Ma Baoyu has piercing eyes and thick eyebrows as his signature features, I'll give Ge Zhenlin a distinctive stocky, muscular build with a square, broad face and prominent flat nose. His physique reflects his 'sturdy build' description, and his alert stance shows his 'keen observation skills.' To further differentiate him, I'll add crossed ammunition bandoliers over his chest, which also emphasizes his ready-for-combat character. The stance will be more alert and ready rather than commanding, befitting a deputy who 'firmly executes orders.'
distinctive_features: Stocky, broad-shouldered muscular build with a square, wide face and prominent flat nose. Crossed cloth ammunition bandoliers over chest.
